com.viaoa.object

Class OAObjectCallback

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.viaoa.object.OAObjectCallback

  • public class OAObjectCallback
extends Object
    Object used to pass data and allow interaction between OAObject callback methods and other (ex: UI) components. OAObject has a class level "callback(OAObjectCallback eq)" method and can have callbackXxx(OAObjectCallback cb)" methods defined for other props,calcs,links, and methods.
    Author:
    vvia
    See Also:
    OAObjectCallbackDelegate, annotation for example
